sticks.title: Sticks & drift
sticks.hintIdle: For an exact drift reading, press “Measure drift” and leave both sticks untouched for 2.5 seconds.
sticks.hintHigh: Drift above 12% is not normal; the potentiometer may be worn or dusty.
sticks.hintHealthy: Drift is within the healthy range.

mic.title: Microphone loopback test
mic.howlingWarning: Do not do this with a headset; acoustic feedback (howling) can damage the speaker.
mic.error: Could not access the microphone. Check the browser permission and the controller connection.

idle.label: Ready
idle.advice: Press “Start test” and allow microphone access.

silent.label: Silent
silent.advice: No signal is coming in. Make sure the controller microphone is selected and the Mute key on the controller is off.

weak.label: Weak
weak.advice: The level is low. Speak closer to the microphone or raise the input level in Windows settings.

good.label: Healthy
good.advice: The signal level is in the normal range; the controller microphone looks healthy.

hot.label: Too loud
hot.advice: The signal is too loud and may distort. Move further away.

clipping.label: Clipping
clipping.advice: The signal is clipping. Lower the input level to remove the distortion.

events.rumbleUnsupported: The controller rejected the rumble report. Try a USB connection.
events.driftStart: Drift measurement started — release the sticks
events.micStart: Microphone test started — speak at a normal volume
events.micSilent: No signal received from the microphone
